skill.summary: Place, list, and retrieve orders via the Zinc API (zinc.com). Use when the user wants to buy a product from an online retailer, check order status, list recent orders, or anything involving the Zinc e-commerce ordering API. Requires ZINC_API_KEY environment variable.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Documentation improved for order polling and status tracking logic.
- Cron job example in SKILL.md simplified for clarity.
- Added instruction to schedule another status check after polling if order is pending/in_progress.
- Minor formatting and list consistency updates in documentation files.
